title: Redfang
summary: Defeat the screechers, control the bats and pursue Redfang through his disappearances.
overview: Defeat the screechers, control the bats and pursue Redfang through his disappearances.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Kill the seven opening screechers to bring out Redfang.
Control the recurring blooddrinkers while damaging the boss.
At 65% and 15%, Redfang disappears and the encounter shifts back to bat control.
Root the voracious bats when appropriate; the script recognizes root as a special response.
Keep the encounter moving to avoid the idle reset.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
